saints.name: St. Edward the Confessor
saints.title: King
saints.shortBlurb: The pious last king of the House of Wessex, remembered for gentleness, generosity, and the building of Westminster Abbey…
biography: Edward was born about 1003, a son of King Æthelred, and spent much of his youth in exile in Normandy before coming to the English throne in 1042. His reign was marked by a reputation for personal holiness, love of the poor, and a peaceable temper, so that he was surnamed “the Confessor.”

He rebuilt the great abbey church of Westminster, where he was buried after his death early in 1066, on the eve of the Norman Conquest. His shrine became a focus of English devotion, and his relics were solemnly translated on 13 October, the day now kept in his memory.
saints.knownFor: Piety as king and the founding of Westminster Abbey.
